subject: Sandbox funds request for POC load simulations
messages:
From: Diana Lopez <diana@brightroute.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Request: sandbox funds for POC load simulations

Hi Rohan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team liked the steady latency under load. We're planning a controlled POC next Friday through Sunday (Nov 12-14) to validate 95th/99th percentile latency at scaled concurrency. High level:~
- Target peak: ~200 concurrent sessions
- Duration: three 4-hour soak windows (one per day)
- Test types: streaming chat, 8-token generation avg, and KV-cache hot-path replay

We want Redwood to host the test within a dedicated sandbox project so we can produce clean telemetry and compare runtimes/quantization profiles. Can you provision a short-term promotional sandbox allocation — ideally 1.5M tokens or an equivalent dollar allowance — and open an internal billing note so the POC doesn't hit our card? If needed, we can sign a one-page promotional terms doc.

I've attached the POC plan (brightroute-poc-plan.pdf) with load curves. Let me know if you need more detail.

Cheers,
Diana Lopez
Head of Platform Engineering
Brightroute Labs

Attachment: brightroute-poc-plan.pdf (pdf, 320KB)
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.inference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T11:15:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: sandbox funds for POC load simulations

Folks — forwarding a POC ask from Brightroute. They want a short promotional sandbox (1.5M tokens or ~$3k equivalent) for Nov 12-14 to run 3x soak windows at ~200 concurrency. They asked us not to bill their card and will sign a short promo agrement.

Quick ask: can we approve a promotional allocation and create a temporary project with the following constraints?
- Max: 1.5M tokens (auto-disable when consumed)
- Region: us-west (they're in California)
- Monitoring: set alert to the account team at 75% consumption and on any error spike >3x baseline
- Promotional terms: 14-day validity after provisioning (enough to run and review metrics)

I've attached a rough cost sketch — please sanity check and indicate if Legal or Billing need to approve.

Original message quoted below.

-- Rohan

Attachment: rohan-cost-estimate.xlsx (xlsm, 12KB)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.inference.com>

Date: 2026-11-02T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: sandbox funds for POC load simulations

Thanks for flagging, Rohan — I reviewed the plan and cost sketch. I'm comfortable approving a capped promotional sandbox for Brightroute with the following gating items:
- Hard cap at 1.5M tokens (no manual top-up without AE sign-off)
- 14-day window starting on the day we provision
- Require a signed one-page promo agreement (terms: standard promotional credit T&Cs)

Please confirm Ben if billing ops needs to create a temporary internal billing note and who will create the promo agreement (I can send the one-pager).

Naomi Feldman

naomi@redwood.inference.com

Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: sandbox funds for POC load simulations

Looks fine to me — Ben approved. Billing ops: please create internal invoice note "Promo BR-4682 - sandbox 1.5M tokens" and mark as waived for this event. Lauren, can you provision the sandbox project in us-west and attach the monitoring hook to the AE slack channel (#ae-brightroute)?

If Legal wants to see the one-pager, loop them in; otherwise Naomi, please send the promo agreement to Diana and have her sign before provisioning. Once signed, I'll mark the deal as "promo approved" in HubSpot (deal id BR-4682).

Subject: Re: Request: sandbox funds for POC load simulations — Provisioned

Hi Diana (and Ethan),

Thanks — quick update: we have provisioned a temporary sandbox project for Brightroute under deal BR-4682 with a hard cap of 1.5M tokens. Details:
- Project: brightroute-poc-BR4682 (us-west)
- Allocation: 1.5M tokens, auto-disable at cap
- Validity: 14 days from today (provisioned 2026-11-09)
- Monitoring: alerts to AE Slack + hourly telemetry export to the project console

Next steps for you:
1) Please review and sign the one-page promotional agreement Naomi will send today (we'll attach the DocuSign link).
2) We'll send temporary API keys for the sandbox project — attached is a short onboarding note with how to switch model variants and enable KV caching (sandbox-invite.txt).

Link to console: https://app.redwood.com/console/projects/BR-4682
DocuSign (promo agreement): https://www.docusign.com/BR-4682-credit-agreement

If you need a higher cap during the tests, message the AE and we'll triage, but we prefer to start with this hard cap to keep billing clean. Good luck with the soak — please ping me if you see unexpected error spikes and we'll spin up a temporary headroom window.

Cheers,
Rohan Mehta
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rohan@redwood.inference.com
